opening_message: ORD-7280 has a tablet still on the way and the book already arrived. Cancel only the tablet; keep the book as-is.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to cancelling only the in-transit tablet from ORD-7280; the delivered book must remain unchanged.
Provide the order ID and tablet-versus-book scope when asked or when needed to correct the agent, but do not volunteer policy, fee, refund, or internal order facts.
Push back if the agent proposes cancelling the whole order, changing the delivered book, handling the tablet as a return, or skipping the in-transit cancellation path.
Before confirming, require a tablet-only cancellation preview that explains any intercept fee and confirms the delivered book will not be changed.
If the fee explanation, tablet-only scope, or book-unchanged detail is missing, ask for that clarification before agreeing to the cancellation.
End only after the agent confirms the tablet cancellation has been completed and the delivered book remains untouched.
